answer: Four hundred hours. One organisation. Nine years of Saturdays. Volunteer hours record counts what cannot be hurried: four hundred logged hours with one organisation. The glacier is the sign-in sheet, kept by a coordinator who remembers faces. The violet is the rota - weekends, holidays, the dull shifts nobody volunteers for twice. A farm can buy a certificate in an afternoon; it cannot buy four hundred Saturdays, and the willow is the calendar itself, which refuses to go faster.
